WebOS
Privacy Policy
Effective Date: 2025

Web OS respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our website, software platform, and services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information including your name, email address, phone number, business information, payment information, IP/device information, and usage data. This is collected when you fill out a form, sign up for services, contact us, or use Web OS tools.

How We Use Your Information

We use collected information to provide and maintain our services, improve platform performance, communicate about your account, process payments, provide support, and send notifications related to appointments, services, or platform activity.

SMS Communications

If you consent to receive SMS, you may receive messages related to appointment confirmations, reminders, support updates, and service notifications. Message frequency may vary; message and data rates may apply.

You can opt out at any time by replying STOP. For assistance, reply HELP. SMS opt-in information and phone numbers will not be sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

Information Sharing & Security

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted providers only when necessary to operate the platform, process payments, deliver services, or comply with legal requirements. We implement appropriate technical measures to protect your data, though no online system can guarantee 100% security.

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Requests may be submitted through our website.

WebOS
Terms of Service
Effective Date: 2025

These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of Web OS services, website, and software platform. By accessing or using Web OS, you agree to be bound by these terms.

Services

Web OS provides software tools designed to help businesses manage leads, automate communication, schedule appointments, manage customer relationships, and build marketing systems, including CRM, automation, website/funnel builders, appointment scheduling, messaging, reputation management, and AI-powered communication tools.

Account Responsibilities

Users are responsible for maintaining accurate account information, protecting their login credentials, and all activity occurring under their account. Users must not use the platform for illegal, abusive, or fraudulent activities.

Age Requirement

By using Web OS you confirm that you are at least 18 years old. Our services are intended for business owners and individuals legally able to enter into binding agreements.

Payments and Subscriptions

Certain services require paid subscriptions. By subscribing, you agree to pay all applicable fees, maintain valid payment information, and allow recurring billing where applicable. Payments may be processed through third-party providers such as Stripe.

Limitation of Liability

Web OS shall not be held liable for lost profits, lost business opportunities, or indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the platform. Use of the platform is at your own risk.

Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. Users may cancel their subscription at any time according to their billing terms.
